title: Collecting the Borderland Science Research Association archive

tellings.quote:
I went to Eureka, California.
>> I met with this guy in his garage
>> and we packed it all together and sent
it back to Sweden.

plain: A researcher named Clas Svahn, who gathers UFO papers and records, told podcast host Jesse Michels how he got the archive of a group called the Borderland Science Research Association. He says he went to Eureka, California, met a man in his garage, and together they packed the whole collection up and shipped it back to Sweden. He tells it as part of how he came to hold so much of this material, which would mean an old body of records now sits safely in one place.
